name: coinvariantsKer_leftRegular_eq_ker
statement: Coinvariants.ker (Representation.leftRegular k G) = LinearMap.ker (linearCombination k (fun _ => (1 : k)))

name: range_norm_eq_ker_applyAsHom_sub
statement: ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g) : LinearMap.range (leftRegular k G).norm.hom.toLinearMap = LinearMap.ker (applyAsHom (leftRegular k G) g - 𝟙 _).hom.toLinearMap
